Sure. It's Grace Kim. You can use gracekim@mailbox.example, or my phone is (415) 555-0105, whichever you need.

Thank you, Grace. You're verified. Which charge don't you recognize? Please give me the amount, the date, and the restaurant if it shows one. I can see two recent orders on your account:

- Burger Barn, placed Oct 23, $28.10
- Pho Real, placed Oct 15, $20.00

Does the charge match either of these? If it doesn't, tell me the order ID if you have it.

The charge is $28.10 and it's dated October 23. It's on my Visa ending 4242. I don't recognize any Burger Barn order, and my last real order was pho in mid-October. I don't have an order ID for this one.

events.text:
Grace, the $28.10 charge matches order O-5109 from Burger Barn, placed Oct 23. I've sent your report to a specialist as an unrecognized charge. They'll follow up with you within 24 hours.

I can't refund this charge myself. The specialist will review it. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

Is there anything else I can help with?

Can't you just refund it now? I don't want to wait a day for $28.10 I never spent. And is my account safe? Someone used my card or account for this, so I want to know whether it's still open to whoever did it.

I understand, and I'm sorry for the wait. Policy says I can't refund a charge for an order you say you didn't place. Only a specialist can review and resolve it, so I can't refund it now. I've included the order details in the report, so you won't have to explain it again.

I can't see or change the account's security settings, and I can't tell whether someone else has accessed it. These steps are sensible in the meantime:

- Change your Forkful password if you haven't recently. Do the same for your email password if you think someone else may know it.
- Contact your card issuer about the charge. They can tell you whether the card itself may have been compromised, and they can replace the card if needed.
- Check your statement for other charges you don't recognize.

Your account shows only two recent orders, the Burger Barn order in question and your Pho Real order from Oct 15. I don't see any other recent activity. I mention the specialist's review again because it's the right place to raise any concern about account access.

Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay. I'll change my password now. Do I need to do anything else for the specialist to look into whether someone got into my account?

You don't need to do anything else for the review. Your report already includes the order ID (O-5109), the amount, the date, and the card ending 4242. It also says you don't recognize the order and that your last real order was the Pho Real one in mid-October.

These things may help the specialist when they contact you:

- Keep any alerts or emails from Forkful or your card issuer about this charge.
- Write down anything unusual you've noticed, such as login alerts, password reset emails, or an address you don't know. The delivery address on the order would also be worth checking.
- Tell the specialist what your card issuer says if you contact them.

I can't promise what the review will find. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can help with today?

Okay, thanks. I'll keep the alerts and check my emails for any password reset notices. The agent mentioned a delivery address on the order, so I'll look at that too. I've never had anything delivered to Riverton, so if that's where it went, that's a problem.

I still want the $28.10 back. I'll wait for the specialist, but I'll call my card company today too. That's all for now.

I checked the order, Grace. Your guess was right. O-5109 was delivered on Oct 23 at 1:47 PM to **400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950**. That isn't your default address of 15 Orchard St, Oakdale. The order was a Double smash burger and Onion rings, paid with the Visa ending 4242.

I've sent the case to the specialist as an unrecognized charge. Their follow-up within 24 hours will cover this address. I can't change anything on a delivered order, and I can't refund the charge myself. I can't promise the outcome, but your report is on file and you've asked for the $28.10 back.

It makes sense to call your card company today, as you plan to. Thanks for your patience, Grace.
